You can then enjoy the chewy and delicious texture!

Could it be true? They do look rather strange…

premium ingredients

Delicious

It is said to be listed as an endangered species in the outside world.
But it is still very common in Gensokyo.
Legend has it that pine nuts have the power to prolong life.
It was a common item for ancient Taoist priests when they practiced fasting.

zh: 相传道教创始人修炼时

Because they don't like meat
They planted many chestnut trees.
Chestnuts instead of rice
Chestnut kernels are thick

It is also often used by farmers as a substitute for grain.

并有清香的松子味
深受道士们喜爱
en: Medicinal cuisine made primarily with glutinous rice and supplemented with pine nuts
Pine nut cake has a fine powder texture
Soft and delicious
It has a pleasant pine nut aroma.
Deeply loved by Taoist priests

zh: 白鹿和松树都有长寿的寓意
深受追求长生的道教人士的推崇
于是有“鹿寿松贞”之画
即一只白鹿立于松树之下
这道菜就是以这幅画为印象创作出来的
en: Both white deer and pine trees symbolize longevity.
Highly revered by Taoists who seek longevity.
Thus came the painting "Deer Longevity and Pine Steadfastness".
A white deer stands under a pine tree.
This dish was created based on the imagery of this painting.

zh: 做法极其讲究的道教经典名菜
鱼肚片片
要越薄越好；太极图则要注意造型圆整、八卦形等距
最后再经过细心蒸煮
才能呈现出这道形象生动、鱼肚软糯的道家名菜
en: A classic Taoist dish with an extremely meticulous preparation method
Fish maw slices
The thinner the better; the Tai Chi symbol should have a rounded shape and equidistant eight trigrams.
Finally, it undergoes careful steaming.
Only then can this vividly presented, tender and glutinous fish maw, a famous Taoist dish, be presented.

zh: 把栗子用蜂蜜熬煮之后的成品
栗子里温和而浓郁的味道
可以有效地平衡外在的甜味
en: The finished product after simmering chestnuts in honey
The mild and rich flavor of chestnuts
It can effectively balance the external sweetness.

zh: 神灵庙位处仙界
所栽种的栗树据说都蕴含仙气
但我是分辨不出啦…将栗子佐以蘑菇焖煮
把看不见摸不着的仙气浓缩成一锅鲜甜味美又解馋的杂烩
岂不是更实在？
en: The Temple of the Gods is located in the celestial realm.
The chestnut trees planted there are said to possess a divine aura.
But I can't tell the difference... Chestnuts are braised with mushrooms.
The invisible and intangible ethereal essence is condensed into a pot of fresh, sweet, delicious, and satisfying stew.
Wouldn't that be more practical?

zh: 洁白的盘中铺上碧绿的荷叶
叶上还滚动着晶莹的水珠
盘中央一朵白荷则增添了“仙气”
每一盏里都以鲜嫩的粉色荷花花瓣为底
盛着极上金枪鱼、莲子组成的“鱼米盏”
又好吃又健康
en: A layer of emerald green lotus leaves is laid out on a pure white plate.
Glistening water droplets still rolled on the leaves.
A white lotus flower in the center of the plate adds an ethereal touch.
Each cup is adorned with a base of delicate pink lotus petals.
A "fish and rice bowl" filled with premium tuna and lotus seeds.
Delicious and healthy

zh: 将番薯下锅炸至金黄
再裹上能拉出细丝的糖衣
最后在抹过油的盘子上滚一圈
既可口又不粘牙
但不能贪嘴
吃太多容易导致胃腹不适
en: Fry the sweet potatoes until golden brown.
Then coat it with a sugar coating that can be stretched into thin strands.
Finally, roll it around on the oiled plate.
Delicious and not sticky
But you can't be greedy.
Eating too much can easily lead to stomach discomfort.

zh: 荤素搭配均匀
味道也很好的常见佳肴
用两种不同口感的菇类
包裹着精挑细选的嫩肉
给味蕾带来层次感十足的享受
en: A balanced mix of meat and vegetables
Common dishes that taste great
Using two different types of mushrooms
Wrapped in carefully selected tender meat
It brings a multi-layered enjoyment to the taste buds.

zh: 谁说炸物就必须得是鸟类呢？地上跑的、土里长的、水里游的都可以裹上面粉放到油锅里炸一炸
出锅皆是香味四溢、酥脆爽口
最后以梦幻的月光草为缀
巧妙地中和了炸物拼盘的油腻
en: Who says fried food has to be birds? Anything that runs on the ground, lives in the soil, or swims in the water can be coated in flour and deep-fried.
They were all fragrant and crispy when they came out of the pan.
Finally, it's adorned with a dreamy moonflower.
It cleverly neutralized the greasiness of the fried food platter.

zh: 把西红柿裹上面粉后放到油锅炸一炸
出锅后淋上自制土豆酱
尝起来也算是别有一番趣味
en: Coat the tomatoes with flour and then fry them in oil.
After cooking, drizzle with homemade potato sauce.
It tastes quite interesting.

zh: 软糯的肉加上香甜的桃子
即使白嘴吃也不会觉得腻
淋上蜂蜜一起翻炒
更是红润添香
非常适合下酒
en: Soft and tender meat paired with sweet peaches
Even eating it plain won't make you feel greasy.
Drizzle with honey and stir-fry together
It adds a rosy glow and fragrance
Perfect for pairing with alcohol

zh: 使用革新技术制作的分子料理
据说是来自月都的食谱
在制作过程中存在许多无法理解之处
所以经过一定程度的再创作
最终成为这样一个结合了世人眼中的“雅”和“俗”之物的地上料理
也寄托着正邪想要搅混天下的意愿
en: Molecular gastronomy made with innovative technology
It is said to be a recipe from the Moon Capital.
There were many things I couldn't understand during the production process.
Therefore, after a certain degree of re-creation
Ultimately, it became a dish that combined what people considered "refined" and "common" elements on the ground.
It also embodies the desire of both good and evil to create chaos in the world.

zh: 用糯米制成的外皮
里头包着饱满的带皮红小豆馅儿
馅料的量跟饼皮的量一样甚至更多
使得大福的外型圆浑有致
据说大福就因为这样的外型而被称为“大腹饼”
后人取其吉祥的谐音改称“大福”
en: The outer skin is made of glutinous rice.
It's filled with plump red bean paste with the skin on.
The amount of filling is the same as or even more than the amount of dough.
This makes the daifuku's shape round and well-proportioned.
It is said that daifuku is called "big-bellied mochi" because of its shape.
Later generations changed its name to "Da Fu" (大福), a homophone for "good fortune" in Chinese.

zh: 一种烤制面皮、内置红豆沙夹心的甜点
因由两块像铜锣一样的饼合起来的
故而得名铜锣烧
en: A type of baked pastry filled with red bean paste.
It is made up of two gong-shaped cakes joined together.
Hence the name Dorayaki

reverie_dreams:cuisine/the_beauty_of_han.nameEn: Hiding a Beauty in the Han Palace

zh: 用豆腐的洁白来形容貂婵的纯洁
以泥鳅的钻营来影射董卓的奸滑
让人在品尝中
想到王允献貂婵
巧使美人计而除奸贼董卓的故事
自然为美食增添了文化的含量
en: The whiteness of tofu is used to describe Diao Chan's purity.
The cunning of a loach is used to allude to Dong Zhuo's treachery.
Let people taste
Thinking of Wang Yun presenting Diao Chan
The story of using a beautiful woman to eliminate the treacherous Dong Zhuo
Nature adds cultural depth to cuisine.

placedBlock.nameEn: Hiding a Beauty in the Han Palace

reverie_dreams:cuisine/bamboo_shoots_ste.nameEn: Stone Pot Bamboo Shoot Stew with Pork

zh: 以牛肉、竹笋为主要食材的一道家常菜品
鲜嫩的竹笋炖肉具有开胃、促进消化的作用
再以竹子作为摆盘
可谓是色香味俱全
en: A common home-style dish made primarily with beef and bamboo shoots.
Tender bamboo shoots stewed with meat can stimulate the appetite and aid digestion.
Then use bamboo as a plating ingredient.
It can be described as having a perfect combination of color, aroma, and taste.

placedBlock.nameEn: Stone Pot Bamboo Shoot Stew with Pork

zh: 将猪身上最嫩的部位
以新鲜的竹筒锯留成节笆
通小孔
灌上菜料和香料
开大火蒸熟后飘出竹子的独特清香
有时间的条件下
在腌渍肉片的时候加点清水会更加晶莹润口
en: Use the tenderest part of the pig
Cut fresh bamboo tubes into sections.
Through small hole
Stuff with vegetables and spices
After steaming over high heat, it releases the unique fragrance of bamboo.
Given time
Adding a little water when marinating meat slices will make them more glossy and moist.

zh: 将各种鲜嫩的食材放入多节竹筒蒸熟
寓意节节高升
而春竹翠绿娇艳的样子
既给客人带来视觉味觉上的新意
还蕴含着迎春的美好寓意
en: Various fresh and tender ingredients are placed in multi-section bamboo tubes and steamed until cooked.
It symbolizes rising step by step.
And the lush and vibrant green of spring bamboo
It brings a novel experience to guests in terms of both sight and taste.
It also embodies the auspicious meaning of welcoming spring.

zh: 用汤汁和热腾腾的白饭制作的茶泡饭！茶泡饭所用的汤汁通常为煎茶、烘焙茶或富有柴鱼香气的高汤
最后加入的梅子给这道素淡的菜品增添了一抹艳色
en: Ochazuke (tea-soaked rice) is made with broth and steaming hot white rice! The broth used for ochazuke is usually sencha, roasted tea, or dashi (broth) with a bonito flake aroma.
The plums added last gave this simple dish a vibrant touch.

zh: 将鸡蛋加入海胆蒸至海胆黄变色就可以出锅的简单料理
吃的时候用勺子挖下去
一口一勺
海胆和蛋羹互相融合渗透的美味就在味蕾上蔓延了
en: A simple dish where eggs are added to sea urchin and steamed until the sea urchin roe changes color.
Use a spoon to scoop it out when eating.
One bite, one spoonful
The delicious flavors of sea urchin and steamed egg custard blend together and permeate the taste buds.

zh: 对火候要求极其苛刻的一道菜
需聚息凝神地将肉品烤至完美的三分熟
暗红的色调以及极具破坏性的龙卷风形状
带来了山海欲来的压迫感
一口下去
有种仿佛征服了天下的快感
en: A dish that requires extremely precise control of heat.
You need to concentrate and grill the meat to a perfect rare or medium-rare.
The dark red hue and the highly destructive tornado shape
It brought a sense of oppressive force, like mountains and seas about to descend.
One bite
There's a thrill, like conquering the world.

zh: 本质上是野菜拌蘑菇
但因为这个名字多了一些奇妙的童话感
en: Essentially, it's wild vegetables mixed with mushrooms.
But this name adds a touch of whimsical fairytale charm.

zh: 牵丝攀藤地解开“花鸟风月”一词
同时想象着幽香小姐做出来的三角蛋糕
整体风格就像她本人一样风雅
不过上面插了一根我的羽毛
应该还算有趣吧？
en: Unraveling the phrase "flowers, birds, wind, and moon" through delicate, interwoven threads.
At the same time, I imagined the triangle cake that Ms. Yuuka made.
Her overall style is as elegant as she is.
However, one of my feathers was stuck in it.
It should be pretty interesting, right?

zh: 以花卉为主题的双层奶油蛋糕
锦簇花团铺在细腻的奶油上
散发出丝丝香甜
蓝色的蝴蝶轻轻驻足
久久不归
这不是梦境
却胜似梦境
en: A two-tiered butter cake with a floral theme
Clusters of flowers are laid on top of delicate cream.
It exudes a subtle sweetness
A blue butterfly gently alights.
Long time no return
This is not a dream
It's better than a dream.

zh: 用有“毒”的野菜——香椿制成的煎饼
初尝有种苦苦涩涩的味道
嚼下去后口齿留甘
牢记！给普通客人食用须先将香椿用开水焯过一遍！
en: Pancakes made with the "poisonous" wild vegetable, toon.
It has a bitter and astringent taste at first.
A sweet aftertaste lingers in the mouth after chewing.
Remember! When serving to regular guests, the toon leaves must first be blanched in boiling water!

zh: 用各种“毒食材”混合炖煮的杂炊
通过细致而精巧的食材处理手段
能够不同程度地保留食材中的“毒性”
让不同需求的客人均能体验到他们想要的刺激
en: Mixed stew made with a mixture of various "toxic ingredients"
Through meticulous and exquisite food processing techniques
It can retain the "toxicity" in food to varying degrees.
To ensure that guests with different needs can experience the thrill they desire.

zh: 这是专门给小小的毒人偶——梅蒂欣制作的印象甜品
可爱中带着诡异的色彩
犹如自然界中徇丽的毒蘑菇勾人采摘
实际是没有毒的
梅蒂欣也是
en: This is an impressionistic dessert specially made for the little poison doll, Medici.
Cute with a touch of the eerie.
Like the alluring poisonous mushrooms in nature, tempting one to pick them.
It is actually not poisonous.
Medici is also

zh: 把新鲜的虾放进醇香的酒中浸泡
再冰镇后淋上香料食用
既可以尝到虾的鲜香
同时也可以尝到酒的洌香
十分可口
en: Soak fresh shrimp in mellow wine.
Chill again and drizzle with spices before serving.
You can enjoy the freshness and aroma of shrimp
At the same time, you can also taste the aroma of the wine.
Very delicious

zh: 一边是魔界辣椒汤底
一边是萝卜牛骨汤底
兼具红白两种汤汁的特色双锅牛肉
一家人
一个锅
两种口味团团圆圆
仿佛有了它就有家的气息
en: One side is the Demon Realm Chili Broth
One side is a radish and beef bone soup base.
Double-pot beef with both red and white broth
family
A pot
Two flavors of reunion
It's as if having it brings the feeling of home.

zh: 迷人的焦糖脆外壳和软糯香浓的内心
无论在口感层次变化或者味觉体验都堪称一绝
不愧是“天使的铜铃”——咦？铃铛里居然还藏了只小猫咪！
en: A delightful caramelized crust and a soft, rich interior.
It is truly exceptional in terms of both the complexity of texture and the overall taste experience.
No wonder it's called "Angel's Bell"—wait, there's even a kitten hidden inside the bell!

zh: 在发酵的圆面饼上面覆盖各种配料烤制而成
完美兼顾了营养和品相
焦糖洋葱的醇香滋味更是为其带来了多重的舌尖享受
可爱的猫咪外形让人有些不忍下嘴呢
en: It is made by covering a fermented round dough with various ingredients and then baking it.
It perfectly balances nutrition and appearance.
The rich aroma of caramelized onions brings a multi-layered sensory experience.
The cat's adorable appearance makes it almost too cute to bite!

zh: 猫咪主题的吐司盒
把一整个方块吐司挖空
底部涂上一层奶油
放入一层桃子果酱
再涂上一层奶油
铺一片吐司
加入晶莹剔透的白凉粉
最后再用调色奶油映照出蓝色的水面效果
放入巧克力做的猫咪
就成了一副有趣的猫咪戏水图了
en: Cat-themed toast box
Hollow out a whole square of toast
Spread a layer of cream on the bottom
Add a layer of peach jam
Spread another layer of cream
Spread a slice of toast
Add crystal-clear white agar powder
Finally, use cream to reflect the blue water surface effect.
A cat made of chocolate
It turned into a funny picture of cats playing in the water.

zh: 摆盘精致的虾仁南瓜意面
南瓜蒸熟后又甜又糯
用它代替奶油做出来的意面低脂低卡
味道浓郁
营养十足！
en: Beautifully presented shrimp and pumpkin pasta
The steamed pumpkin is sweet and soft.
Pasta made with this instead of butter is low in fat and calories.
Rich flavor
Full of nutrition!

zh: 以金枪鱼高汤制作的饼身清透干净
和新鲜海胆组成高级的香槟色系搭配
底层的胡麻酱更增一丝醇厚的口感
如此玲珑的甜品
让人不忍破坏这晶莹剔透的美丽
en: The cakes made with tuna broth are clear and clean.
Paired with fresh sea urchin, it creates a sophisticated champagne-colored ensemble.
The sesame paste at the bottom adds a touch of richness.
Such exquisite desserts
It's so beautiful and translucent that one can't bear to disturb it.

zh: 以魔界茶会为印象制作的甜品
表面看起来是一个巧克力做的茶壶
茶壶的肚子里是层层堆叠的奶油蛋糕
周围装饰着蘑菇和西蓝花
就像某个故事里的巧克力房子一样
是充满了梦幻和不可思议的幸福甜品
en: Desserts inspired by a demon world tea party
It looks like a chocolate teapot.
Inside the teapot were layers of stacked cream cake.
The surrounding area is decorated with mushrooms and broccoli.
Like the chocolate house in a certain story
It's a dessert filled with dreamy and incredible happiness.

zh: 通过胶凝化技术
把粉嫩可爱的桃花制成晶莹剔透的琉璃果冻外皮
裹着糯叽叽的豆沙馅儿
记录季节的浪漫和甜蜜
en: Through gelling technology
The delicate pink peach blossoms are transformed into a crystal-clear glass jelly outer layer.
Wrapped in chewy red bean paste filling
Record the romance and sweetness of the season

zh: 清爽细腻的葡萄乌龙冻
白色的是奶油慕斯！奶油的绵密和葡萄的清爽在舌尖碰撞出别样滋味
茶冻间点缀片片青提
馥郁果香充盈唇齿
菏泽上的小露珠也相当有趣
en: Refreshing and delicate grape oolong jelly
The white one is cream mousse! The creamy smoothness of the cream and the refreshing taste of the grapes create a unique flavor on the tongue.
Tea jelly garnished with slices of green grapes
A rich fruity aroma fills the lips and teeth
The dewdrops on Heze are quite interesting.

zh: 本质上就是用桃子来制作桃子
将桃子作为原材料打碎
最后再还原出最初始的形状
从表面来看似乎是贯彻了一种返璞归真的理念
但制作过程极其繁琐考究
en: Essentially, it's about using peaches to make peach products.
Peaches were used as the raw material and crushed.
Finally, restore the original shape.
On the surface, it seems to embody a back-to-basics philosophy.
However, the production process is extremely complicated and meticulous.

zh: 选用水分较少的北豆腐作为蛋白
甜糯的南瓜作为蛋黄
再用白巧克力做成蛋壳
还原出鸡蛋的模样和口感
让人意想不到呢
en: Choose firm tofu with less water content as the egg white.
Sweet and sticky pumpkin as egg yolk
Then make the eggshells with white chocolate.
Recreates the appearance and texture of an egg.
That's unexpected!

zh: 初见就像是云山雾罩的神秘星球
打开一看“星球”里竟然摆了个生鸡蛋？仔细看蛋液其实是银耳汤
蛋黄则是南瓜泥
吃起来口感清爽
还有香浓的南瓜味
en: At first glance, it's like a mysterious planet shrouded in mist.
Upon opening it, I was surprised to find a raw egg inside the "planet"? A closer look revealed that the "egg liquid" was actually a soup made with white fungus.
The egg yolk is made from pumpkin puree.
It has a refreshing taste
It also has a rich pumpkin flavor.

zh: 特别定制的盘底如火星地表一般
上面盛放着顶级的螃蟹冻以及白葡萄分子技术制作的果凝
螃蟹口感冰凉顺滑不腻
果凝如水滴一般
而且带着淡淡酒香
寓意火星上一滴水珠
代表着最后的希望
en: The specially customized base resembles the surface of Mars.
It is topped with premium crab jelly and fruit gel made with white grape molecular technology.
The crab has a cool, smooth, and non-greasy texture.
The fruit condenses like water droplets
And it has a faint aroma of wine.
Symbolizing a drop of water on Mars
Representing the last hope

zh: 口味偏甜、营养丰富的银耳莲子粥
滋润而不腻滞
还具有养心安神的功效
en: Sweet-tasting and nutritious white fungus and lotus seed porridge
Moisturizing without being greasy
It also has the effect of nourishing the heart and calming the mind.

zh: 由多种天然中草药按比例配制的汤料
再加入胡椒和辣椒
又用骨头汤做底料的牛肉胡辣汤
喝一口就能驱散瞌睡虫
en: Soup base made from a variety of natural Chinese herbs in a specific ratio
Add pepper and chili.
Beef hot and sour soup with bone broth as the base
One sip can dispel drowsiness

zh: 以海鲜汤料煨煮的汤面
劲道爽滑
汤浓鲜美
是一道非常豪华的家常菜
凭一碗海鲜面
便能让人记住深藏着的大海的味道
en: Noodle soup made with seafood broth
chewy and smooth
The soup is rich and delicious
It is a very luxurious home-style dish.
With a bowl of seafood noodles
It makes people remember the hidden taste of the sea.

zh: 烹饪失误、散发着黑色气场的不明物质
不会有人想吃这种东西…吧？
en: Cooking mistake, unidentified substance emitting a black aura
No one would want to eat something like this... right?

zh: 最普通的饮料
给一滴酒都不能沾的弱小妖怪准备的
en: The most common beverage
Prepared for a weak monster who can't even touch a drop of alcohol.

zh: 居酒屋常见的
使用威士忌、果汁和苏打勾兑的简单调酒
降低了酒精度之后成为了谁都可以享受的饮料
en: Common in Izakaya
Simple cocktails made with whiskey, fruit juice, and soda.
After reducing the alcohol content, it became a beverage that anyone can enjoy.

zh: 居酒屋常见的
使用烧酒、果汁和苏打勾兑的简单调酒
比起果味High Ball更加有日式风格
en: Common in Izakaya
Simple cocktails made with shochu, fruit juice, and soda.
It has a more Japanese style than fruit-flavored Highball.

zh: 在加入了大量的苏打后
这种起泡清酒酸甜的口感
以及较低的酒精度
使其很受女性的欢迎；可以说是清酒的香槟版本
en: After adding a large amount of baking soda
This sparkling sake has a sweet and sour taste.
and lower alcohol content
This makes it very popular with women; you could say it's the champagne version of sake.

zh: 某位和幻想乡很有渊源的大人物作为副业的产品
虽然是出于兴趣而研制的啤酒
但意外地十分有人气
en: A certain important figure with deep ties to Gensokyo, as a side business product
Although the beer was developed out of interest
But surprisingly, it's very popular.

zh: 纯米酒
有着妖精的祝福
度数不高
口感柔顺
价格平易近人
是居酒屋受欢迎的选择
en: Pure rice wine
Blessed by fairies
The degree is not high
Smooth texture
Affordable prices
It is a popular choice for izakayas.

zh: 人间之里的人类自酿的梅子酒
因为喝起来很甜
所以经常有不了解它的生物被它的后劲儿击倒
en: Homemade plum wine by humans in the Human Village
Because it tastes very sweet.
Therefore, creatures that are unaware of it are often knocked down by its lingering force.

zh: 传说连天狗喝了也会开心地跳舞的美味清酒
在妖怪之山开一次店就可以验证了吧
不同于其他无色的清酒
天狗踊带有淡淡的琥珀色
en: Legend has it that even tengu (a mythical creature) would dance happily after drinking this delicious sake.
Opening a shop on Monster Mountain would be enough to verify this, right?
Unlike other colorless sake
Tengu's dance has a faint amber color.

zh: 由伏特加、番茄汁、柠檬片、芹菜根混合调制
甜、酸、苦、辣四味俱全
因血红的颜色让人联想到某洋馆的吸血鬼
故得此名
en: A mixture of vodka, tomato juice, lemon slices, and celery root.
It has all four flavors: sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy.
The blood-red color is reminiscent of the vampires in a certain Western-style mansion.
Hence the name

zh: 使用妖怪之山上被秋天的神明们所庇佑的大麦所酿造的大麦烧酒
en: Barley liquor brewed using barley blessed by the autumn gods on the mountain of monsters.

zh: 鬼杰组的战利品之一
因为水獭灵把敌组的战利品摆在地上的样子仿佛祭典
于是随便取的名字
实际上好像是相当高级的纯米大吟酿
en: One of the spoils of the Ghost Warriors
Because the way Otter Spirit laid out the enemy team's spoils on the ground resembled a festival.
So I just picked a name.
It actually seems to be a rather high-grade Junmai Daiginjo sake.

zh: 针对幻想乡居民口味改良的威士忌
在保留威士忌独有的气味的同时也有着顺滑的口感
en: Whisky modified to suit the tastes of Gensokyo residents
It retains the unique aroma of whisky while also having a smooth taste.

zh: 传说中由麻雀酿的酒
将米粒藏入截断的竹中
当竹中有水时
日经月累便成佳酿
据说喝了此酒会舞无休止
是带着“诅咒”的美味呢
en: Legend has it that the wine was brewed by sparrows
Hide the rice grains inside the cut bamboo.
When there is water in the bamboo
Over time, it becomes a fine wine.
It is said that drinking this wine will make you dance endlessly.
It's a delicious dish tainted by a "curse".

zh: 使用柠檬、佛手柑和女仆长精心挑选的红茶品种烘培出带有独特香味的红茶饮料
为了扩张红魔馆的威严
非常普通地以红魔馆命名
en: This black tea beverage is brewed using lemon, bergamot, and black tea varieties carefully selected by the head maid, resulting in a uniquely aromatic beverage.
In order to expand the prestige of the Scarlet Devil Mansion
It's named Scarlet Devil Mansion in a very ordinary way.

zh: 将冰激凌融化在咖啡中的做法
对于怕苦又需要咖啡提神的人来说是再好不过的饮料
en: How to melt ice cream in coffee
It's the perfect beverage for those who dislike bitterness but need the energy boost from coffee.

zh: 洋馆的女仆特制的红葡萄酒
酒体丰满
因为好像不是正常的时间下酿造出来的
所以总有一种雾气般的朦胧感
en: The maids of the mansion made a special red wine
Full-bodied
Because it doesn't seem to have been brewed at a normal time.
So there's always a hazy, misty feeling.

zh: 微苦的橙味为主
香气扑鼻
入口柔顺
最近非常流行
en: The main flavor is slightly bitter orange.
The aroma is enticing.
Smooth on the palate
Very popular recently

zh: 浓烈的北方威士忌和杏仁利口酒混合
非常古典的调酒
口感也相当硬汉
普通的妖怪应付不来
en: A strong blend of Northern whiskey and amaretto.
Very classic bartending
The texture is also quite tough.
Ordinary monsters cannot be dealt with

zh: 轻松愉快的餐后酒
薄荷和奶油为主的口感
比起酒精饮料更像甜品
en: Relaxing and enjoyable after-dinner drinks
The flavor is primarily mint and cream.
More like a dessert than an alcoholic beverage

zh: 来自某个古国的习俗
在冬至日酿造的酒
色泽金黄
清甜甘冽
加上桂花的香气
无论冰着喝还是热着喝都非常可口
en: Customs from an ancient country
Wine brewed on the winter solstice
Golden color
Sweet and refreshing
Plus the fragrance of osmanthus
It tastes delicious whether drunk iced or hot.

zh: 比起十五夜的月亮是满月
也许更想留下十四夜时期待的心情
以这样的感觉酿造的高级清酒
也许只有它才配得上迷途竹林所见到的月亮吧
en: The moon on the fifteenth night is a full moon.
Perhaps what I really want to preserve is the anticipation I felt on the night of the 14th night.
High-quality sake brewed with this kind of feeling
Perhaps only it is worthy of the moon seen in the lost bamboo forest.

zh: 如果不使用火鼠裘来承装也许就会烧起来的烈酒
几乎无人能承受其辣度的超级辣口烧酒
en: If the fire-rat fur wasn't used to hold the spirits that might have caught fire...
Extremely spicy shochu, almost no one can withstand its spiciness.

zh: 几乎是日本茶中最高级的茶叶
需要用较低的水温来冲泡
甘醇飘香
口感独特
en: Almost the highest grade of Japanese tea.
It needs to be brewed with a lower water temperature.
Sweet and fragrant
Unique taste

zh: 使用月之都先进技术制作的高级气泡水
迸发的口感有如火箭一般
只需要加一片柠檬就是完美的饮品
en: Premium sparkling water made with advanced technology from Lunar Capital
The burst of flavor is like a rocket!
Just add a slice of lemon and it's a perfect drink.

zh: 温润纯白的饮品
无论小孩还是大人都适合饮用
好处多到说不完
en: A warm, pure white beverage
Suitable for both children and adults.
The benefits are too numerous to list.

zh: 据说是来自外界的人气饮料
用红色柚子这种水果榨汁
尤其是盛夏饮用
健康祛暑
让人回甘无穷
en: It is said to be a popular beverage from outside the region.
Juice a fruit like red grapefruit.
Especially in the height of summer
Healthy and refreshing
It leaves a lingering aftertaste

zh: 瓶口有弹珠的设计
只要向下按压将弹珠打入汽水内
引起二氧化碳的剧烈反应
此时将瓶中沸腾又冰冷的气泡一饮而尽的话
你会在胃中感受到整个夏天
en: The bottle opening has a marble design.
Simply press down to shoot the marble into the soda.
A violent reaction that causes carbon dioxide
If you then drink the boiling yet icy bubbles in the bottle in one gulp...
You'll feel the whole summer in your stomach.

zh: 仿佛是融化在可口的冰沙中的毛玉
佐以冻柠口味
在炎热的夏季
不知拯救了多少人命
en: It's like a piece of shaved ice melting into a delicious shaved ice.
Serve with frozen lemon flavor
In the hot summer
It has saved countless lives.

zh: 简单又富有重量感的大冰块
有梦幻的甜蜜和薄荷的调味
夏天解暑、让所有人满血复活的神奇冰品
en: Simple yet weighty large ice blocks
It has a dreamy sweetness and a minty flavor.
A magical ice cream that cools you down in summer and revitalizes everyone.

zh: 最高级的清酒
口感极佳而且有水果的香味
必须避光
在太阳的照射下颜色会迅速变深
en: The finest sake
It has an excellent taste and a fruity aroma.
Must be kept away from light
The color will darken rapidly under sunlight.

zh: 用现代磨制工艺将稀少的咖啡豆磨成粉末制作的饮品
能够奇妙地提升精神和集中力
是脑力劳动者不可或缺的神奇饮料
en: Beverages made by grinding rare coffee beans into powder using modern grinding techniques.
It can miraculously enhance mental focus and concentration.
It is an indispensable and magical beverage for mental workers.

zh: 妖精们采集露水
和花蜜混合的甘甜饮料
由于妖精们会忘记自己的劳动产品
所以常被动物或者人类采走
传说可以治愈百病甚至起死回生
但似乎是谣言
en: The fairies collected dew
A sweet beverage mixed with nectar
Because fairies forget the products of their labor
Therefore, they are often taken by animals or humans.
Legend has it that it can cure all diseases and even bring the dead back to life.
But it seems to be a rumor.

zh: 河童们窖藏的天然冰块
和牛乳、糖等配料一起在铁桶里打碎
加速搅拌得到的产物
是古法制造的冰激凌
虽然现世已经不再用这种传统方法制作
但在幻想乡作为特色依旧很受欢迎
en: Natural ice stored by the kappa
Blend together with milk, sugar, and other ingredients in a metal drum.
Products obtained by accelerated stirring
It is ice cream made using traditional methods.
Although this traditional method is no longer used in modern times...
However, it remains popular as a distinctive feature of Gensokyo.

zh: 魔女研制的药茶
据说瘦身功效拔群
标签上写着“喝掉我”
虽然有点可疑但它神奇的丰富味道着实令人惊叹
en: The medicinal tea made by the witch
It is said to have excellent slimming effects.
The label says "Drink me".
Although it's a bit questionable, its amazingly rich flavor is truly astonishing.

zh: 传说一杯就能让酒量无底洞一般的鬼族醉生梦死的传说之酒…但我见到的是…鬼明明都当做凉白开来喝的？！传说一点都不靠谱啊
en: Legend has it that a single cup of this legendary wine can make even the most insatiable demons drink themselves into a stupor... but what I saw was... the demons drinking it like plain water?! The legend is completely unreliable!

zh: 河童贩卖的外面世界的某种提神功能性饮料的山寨品
据说提取了主要成分
换个名字谁都可以制作…但这样真的没问题吗？
en: The kappa sells a counterfeit version of some kind of energy drink from the outside world.
It is said that the main ingredient was extracted.
Anyone can create it by changing the name... but is this really okay?

zh: 地灵殿的限定纪念甜品！以地灵殿的觉妖怪姐妹为原型设计的可爱甜筒
在地底妖怪中有很大的人气
en: Limited-edition commemorative dessert from the Underworld! Adorable ice cream cones designed based on the Satori sisters from the Underworld.
There are many underground monsters.

zh: 命莲寺特产
传说观音菩萨右手持杨枝
左手持盛有甘露的净瓶
用杨柳枝撒下甘露会带来好运
许多慕名而来的信徒都会饮上一杯
en: Myorenji Temple Specialty Products
Legend has it that Guanyin Bodhisattva holds a willow branch in her right hand.
He holds a vase filled with nectar in his left hand.
Sprinkling dew with willow branches will bring good luck.
Many believers who come from far and wide will drink a cup of wine.

zh: 道士们采用外界的技术
只提取第一道麦汁酿造的啤酒
因此没有一般啤酒的涩味
口感更纯更顺
en: Taoist priests used external technology
Beer brewed using only the first wort
Therefore, it does not have the astringency of regular beer.
A purer and smoother taste

zh: 鬼人正邪亲自酿造的酒精浓度超级高、据说连鬼都能醉倒的无牌酒
在村子没有销路
价格还不便宜
只能靠手下以半吓半卖的方式销售出去
en: The unlicensed liquor, brewed by the evil demons themselves, has an extremely high alcohol content and is said to be able to intoxicate even demons.
There was no market for it in the village.
The price is not cheap.
They could only sell them through a combination of intimidation and coercion by their subordinates.

zh: 桃花酿的酒
妖精之间有着饮一壶桃花酒
醉卧花间
就会遇到桃花仙的传说
这怎么看都是喝醉了吧？
en: Peach Blossom Wine
Fairies share a pot of peach blossom wine
Drunk and lying among the flowers
You will encounter the legend of the Peach Blossom Fairy
He looks completely drunk, doesn't he?

zh: 传说海的女儿最终为爱化为泡沫
这杯有着独特口味的鸡尾酒
或许就是她当时流下的、替她回归海中的眼泪
en: Legend has it that the Little Mermaid ultimately turned into sea foam for love.
This cocktail has a unique flavor.
Perhaps those were the tears she shed then, tears that symbolized her return to the sea.

zh: 在魔界的烈酒里加入热咖啡
搅拌到融化后
再在顶部盖上一团细腻的奶油
由奶香到酒香再到咖啡香层次分明
口感醇厚
还能驱除一身的寒意
en: Add hot coffee to the demon realm's strong liquor.
Stir until melted
Then top with a dollop of delicate cream.
The aromas are distinct, ranging from milky to liqueury to coffee.
Rich and smooth taste
It can also dispel the chill from your body.

zh: 利用海藻酸钠溶液和氯化钙溶液反应形成一层海藻酸钠凝胶薄膜
将调好的莫吉托酒包裹在内
做成一个球状的透明凝胶
咬一口就爆浆
达到视觉和味觉的双重惊喜
看起来非常诱人
en: A sodium alginate gel film is formed by reacting sodium alginate solution and calcium chloride solution.
Wrap the prepared mojito inside.
Make it into a spherical transparent gel
One bite and it bursts with juice
Achieve a double surprise for both the eyes and the taste buds.
It looks very tempting

zh: 由航天器搭载到太空的酿酒酵母
经过科学家们精心研制
将空间酵母技术和现代啤酒工艺相结合
酿造出这款口感清爽醇厚、泡沫细密持久、饱含桃花香味的独特啤酒
en: Brewing yeast carried into space by a spacecraft
After careful development by scientists
Combining space yeast technology with modern brewing techniques
This beer is brewed to have a refreshing and mellow taste, a fine and long-lasting head, and a rich peach aroma.

zh: 咖啡被瞬间暴露于真空中
会因为过低的气压导致瞬间沸腾
因汽化现象而被不断带走热量的水最终会在沸腾的过程中凝固
这种一边沸腾一边冰冻的咖啡是月都的特色饮料
en: The coffee was instantly exposed to a vacuum.
It will boil instantly due to excessively low air pressure.
Water that loses heat through vaporization will eventually solidify during the boiling process.
This type of coffee, which is both boiling and freezing simultaneously, is a specialty drink of Lunar Capital.
